evidence_quotes: Het bestemmingsplan, de omgevingsvergunningen, de watervergunning en de leggerwijziging maken het wind- en zonnepark Energielandgoed Wells Meer mogelijk.
Bij besluit van 9 februari 2021 heeft de raad van de gemeente Bergen het bestemmingsplan "Energielandgoed Wells Meer" vastgesteld.
rationale: This Dutch Raad van State decision concerns the coordinated spatial-planning and permitting package enabling the 400-hectare wind and solar development 'Energielandgoed Wells Meer' in Bergen, explicitly encompassing a Waterwet permit ('de watervergunning') and a waterboard register modification ('de leggerwijziging') alongside the municipal zoning plan ('bestemmingsplan') and environmental permits ('omgevingsvergunningen'). Because explicit Waterwet/waterboard instruments ('watervergunning' and 'leggerwijziging') form part of the coordinated spatial development under review, the decision falls within WATER under spatial_planning_water, though confidence is medium because the summary does not detail the specific water-law grounds challenged. It does not involve household water connection or informal settlements.
